subject: general
question: Where is the Tata Aircraft Complex, inaugurated in October 2024 to manufacture C-295 aircraft, located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vadodara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Location:** The **Tata Aircraft Complex**, inaugurated in **October 2024** to manufacture **C-295 aircraft**, is situated in **Vadodara, Gujarat**. This facility is a significant milestone in India’s aviation sector.
 
• **Purpose:** The Tata Aircraft Complex is designed to manufacture **C-295 military transport aircraft**, which will replace the aging fleet of Indian Air Force’s **Avro aircraft**. It is aimed at boosting India's defense infrastructure and indigenous manufacturing capabilities.
 
• **Significance:** The establishment of this facility aligns with the **Make in India** initiative, promoting **self-reliance** in defense production. It is the **first-ever private sector aircraft manufacturing facility in India**.
 
• **Partnership:** The project is a collaborative effort between **Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL)** and **Airbus Defence and Space**. This partnership marks a significant step in **India’s defense modernization**.
 
• **Production Details:** The facility will produce **56 C-295 aircraft** for the Indian Air Force. Out of these, **40 aircraft** will be manufactured at the Vadodara facility, while the initial 16 will be assembled in Spain.
 
• **Employment Opportunities:** The complex is expected to generate employment for thousands of people, including direct and indirect jobs in **Gujarat** and other parts of India, contributing to the growth of the aviation and defense sectors.
 
• **Strategic Advantage:** By manufacturing advanced transport aircraft domestically, India aims to reduce dependency on foreign imports and enhance its strategic autonomy in defense technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **C-295 Aircraft:**

 
 
• The **C-295** is a **tactical military transport aircraft** designed by **Airbus Defence and Space**. It is known for its **versatility**, including its ability to transport troops, equipment, and perform medical evacuations.
 
• The aircraft can operate in adverse weather conditions and is equipped with advanced systems, making it suitable for **military and humanitarian missions.**
 
• The C-295 is capable of operating on **short or unprepared airstrips**, which is crucial for operations in remote areas.
 
 
 
• **Make in India Initiative:**
 
 
• Launched in **2014**, this initiative aims to transform India into a global design and manufacturing hub by encouraging indigenous production across sectors, including defense.
 
• The establishment of the Tata Aircraft Complex is part of this initiative, showcasing **India’s commitment to becoming self-reliant** in defense production.
 
 
 
• **Airbus and TASL Partnership:**
 
 
• The collaboration between **Airbus Defence and Space** and **Tata Advanced Systems Limited** is a landmark venture in India’s aerospace sector.
 
• It not only boosts the domestic manufacturing of aircraft but also brings advanced technology and expertise to India, enhancing the country’s industrial base.
 
 
 
• **India’s Defense Modernization:**
 
 
• The establishment of facilities like the Tata Aircraft Complex is crucial for modernizing India’s defense infrastructure and enhancing its operational capabilities.
 
• This step ensures that India moves closer to achieving strategic autonomy by reducing reliance on foreign defense imports.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Economic Impact:**

 
 
• The Tata Aircraft Complex will contribute to India’s economy by creating **employment opportunities**, enhancing manufacturing capabilities, and fostering innovation in the defense sector.
 
• It is expected to bring **global recognition** to India’s aerospace and defense industries.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance:**
 
 
• The facility strengthens India’s **national security** by ensuring the availability of advanced military aircraft.
 
• The project marks a significant step toward achieving the vision of a **self-reliant India** in defense production.
